metadata.coverage: Cassini clear-filter observations projected onto the released PDS shape using its measured camera geometry. Bounded illumination correction and exposure matching reduce photographed lighting. Gray grid marks unavailable samples; cast-shadow terrain is not reconstructed.

celestial.sunSource: Vendored JPL Saturn satellite orbit and the Archinal rotation frame documented with the PDS shape model.

panel.introduction: Pandora is an irregular icy moon just outside Saturn’s F ring. Its gravity disturbs the ring, and Cassini revealed grooves, ridges and craters softened by a coating of fine debris.

controls.label: Monochrome
controls.description: Cassini clear-filter observations projected onto the released PDS shape using its measured camera geometry. Bounded illumination correction and exposure matching reduce photographed lighting. Gray grid marks unavailable samples; cast-shadow terrain is not reconstructed.
controls.title: ISS mosaic
controls.summary: Brightness matching reduces photographed shading. The gray grid marks missing coverage and terrain hidden in cast shadows.

controls.label: False color
controls.description: Cassini IR3, GRN, UV3 filters displayed as red, green and blue; observed illumination and common coverage only.
controls.title: Cassini false color
controls.summary: Measured filter bands in false color; this does not reproduce human-visible color. Gray grid marks missing common coverage; photographed shadows remain.

controls.label: Elevation
controls.description: Radial height above a 40.6 km reference sphere from the Cassini shape model. Includes the moon’s broad irregular shape; it is not local height above a geoid. Fixed relief lighting reveals model slopes. Small craters are not reliably resolved.
controls.title: Shape-derived radial height
controls.summary: Height relative to a 40.6 km sphere, from the Cassini shape model. Small craters are unresolved.
